attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Quarter and Half Year (Q2 and H1) ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited disclosed the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published on November 15, 2026, in the Financial Express and Arthik Lipi newspapers. The company submitted this information to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement includes copies of the newspaper publications. No other financial data or specific figures are provided in this text.

attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Financial Results".
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited filed a press release regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for Q2 and H1 FY27, ending 30 September 2026. Total income was 4,806 Mn for Q2 and 9,705 Mn for H1. EBITDA stood at 312 Mn for Q2 and 1,031 Mn for H1. The company operated 283 stores as of 30 September 2026, expanding to 293 stores by 6 November 2026. Retail area was 2.68 Mn sq. ft. Customer activity included 10.93 Mn bills and 39.4 Mn units sold during H1. Private labels contributed 61% of H1 sales. The company set a turnover ambition of 25,000 Mn for FY27, scaling to 38,000 Mn in FY28 and 56,000 Mn in FY29. The goal is to expand the retail network to 600 stores by FY29.

attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled " Growth & Expansion Roadmap .".
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited issued a press release on November 14, 2026, detailing its growth and expansion roadmap. The company reported H1 FY27 turnover of Rs. 965 Cr and currently operates 293 stores across 10 states. It targets Rs. 2,500 Cr turnover in FY27, Rs. 3,800 Cr in FY28, and Rs. 5,600 Cr in FY29. The store network aims to reach 600 stores by FY29. Additionally, the company plans a 325 MW solar power project through its subsidiary Sunright Private Limited. This project involves acquiring 1,000 acres of land and is expected to save Rs. 30 Crores annually in electricity expenses. The project targets full operational status within 24 months, subject to approvals and execution milestones.

attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was Rs. 4,785 Mn, with EBITDA at Rs. 312 Mn and PAT at minus Rs. 321 Mn. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 9,649 Mn, with EBITDA at Rs. 1,031 Mn. The company reported 283 stores across 10 states as of September 30, 2026. Own brands accounted for 61% of H1 FY27 sales. The company guided for year-on-year revenue growth of 25% for the full year.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026- in relation to the preferential issue of Baazar Style Retail Limited
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company enclosed the monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited. This report concerns the utilization of proceeds from the Preferential Issue of Share Warrants. It also covers the partial conversion of shares warrant into equity shares. The report is for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Abinash Singh, Chief Compliance Officer, signed the letter on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about re-constitution of committees of the Board of Directors of the Company.
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the re-appointment of Dr. Dhanpat Ram Agarwal as Non-Executive Independent Director for three years effective March 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved the re-appointment of Mr. Bhagwan Prasad as Whole-time Director for three years effective February 4, 2027, subject to shareholder approval. Additionally, Mr. Avishek Prasad was appointed as Whole-time Director for three years effective November 14, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. The Board reconstituted the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee, and Risk Management Committee with effect from November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Baazar Style Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
voiceSummary: Baazar Style Retail Limited incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named Sunright Private Limited on November 12, 2026. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs issued the Certificate of Incorporation on the same day. Sunright Private Limited operates in the Renewal Energy Sector, specifically for setting up and undertaking Solar Power generation projects and other allied activities. The subsidiary is a related party to Baazar Style Retail Limited. It is located in India. The initial share capital was subscribed in cash at the time of incorporation and issued at face value. Turnover and net worth are not applicable as the company is newly incorporated and has not commenced business operations. Baazar Style Retail Limited holds 100% shareholding in Sunright Private Limited. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
